ns2:course.label: Lab Animal Science II
ns2:course.description: Continuation of VCM 646. Additional topics in laboratory animal science including the biology, husbandry, and medicine of commonly studied laboratory animal species, researcher presentations on their animal studies, and student-led animal model presentations 1 graduate hour. 1 professional hour. Approved for Letter and S/U grading. Prerequisite: VCM 646 or equivalent, or consent of instructor.
